_comment: `answerable` queries name the lesson that should come back first. `expect` is
matched case-insensitively against the lesson title, so it only needs to be
`unanswerable` queries have no answer anywhere in the corpus. The tutor must
decline rather than reach for the nearest thing, so what matters is that their
best score stays BELOW the worst answerable score. That gap is the number that
predicts whether a student asking about physics gets an Arabic poem.
This set describes the placeholder corpus. When the real curriculum is indexed,
replace these entries — the harness does not change.

answerable.q: how do I subtract two numbers
what does regrouping mean in subtraction

unanswerable.q: what is the capital of Brazil
who won the world cup in 1998
explain Newton's first law of motion
